_doc: Config of the generic grade-beam (GB) zone pipeline (extc.py -> build.py -> post_r02.py). Pass it with env GBZ_CONFIG. ALL VALUES BELOW ARE PLACEHOLDERS / EXAMPLES. Keys starting with '_' are comments. Paths: 'root' relative to this file, every other path relative to root. Text fields are format strings: {zone} = zone name (upper case), {prj} = project, {rev} = zone revision; dwg patterns also {no}.
_root: working dir: holds <zone>/ input folders, <zone>_<part>/ extraction folders, <zone>_build/, src/ (rotated plans) and out/
_layout_json: sheet layout file (gen_gbsec style): keys layout, scales, prefer_side, model_origin, top_lap, right_margin_th, text_style, dxfversion, frame{title positions}

frame._doc: title block: block name inside block_dxf; defaults = extra title fields (override ref/area/venue/rev/date); optional 'title' {field: [x, y, h]} replaces the layout_json title positions

schedule._doc: EXAMPLE VALUES ONLY. Per GB type: nb/db bottom bars, nba/dba bottom additional, nt/dt top, nta/dta top additional, ds stirrup dia, s stirrup spacing at supports, s_mid at midspan; optional h (default beam_h)

_default_type: type given to a beam with no label on the plan (RFI remark) and to the generated supporting beams of curved lines
_cantilever_type: schedule key / plan label prefix of cantilever spans (label inside a span -> that span uses it)
_top_gb: T.O.GB level in mm (B.O.GB = top_gb - beam_h)
cd_legend: b = PLAN WIDTH (200 / 300), h = GB SCHEDULE DEPTH {h}.
DIMENSIONS IN mm, LEVELS IN m.
_cd_legend: CONC DIM legend lines; {top} {bot} in m with sign, {h} in mm
_free_end_note: suffix of the remark / hold text of a classified free end, e.g. ' (RFI REPLY dd/mm)'

typical.caption: TYPICAL DETAIL OF CONTINUOUS GROUND BEAM R.F.T. + GROUND BEAM SCHEDULE
typical._doc: TYPICAL DETAILS sheet (FIRST+3): entities of 'dxf' whose bbox centre is in 'window' are imported at the same coordinates (keep that model area free); blocks inserted inside explode_window are exploded first; sheet viewport = window at 1:scale

curved_notes: 1. TOP AND BOTTOM BARS FOLLOW THE BEAM CURVE ...
_curved_notes: optional: notes of the CURVED BEAMS sheet; omit for the built-in generic notes ({hook} = stirrup hook)

label: S-COLS-IDEN
S-BEAM-IDEN
layers._doc: consultant layers: beam edges, columns (outlines / hatches / circles), beam + column labels; purge_prefixes = source layers removed from the PLAN / CONC DIM copies

zone_defaults._doc: applied to every zone before its own keys (any zone key / flag)

z1.name: Z1
z1._parts: [name, extra_deg, 'x0,y0,x1,y1' region in the base_deg frame]; P1 (first) = the plan frame of the sheets
z1._rev_rows: title block revision rows: [text, x, align, (row index)] as gen_gbsec rev_row
z1._sog_note: appended to the SOG sheet caption after ' - ' (e.g. an RFI reference)

_zone_files: optional inputs in <root>/<zone>/: eng_marks.json {circles, targets?, mode?}, curves.json [{code, w, L, pts, sup, tlab, ext?}], line_edits.json, eng_add.json {lines, texts}, sog_eng.json, secnames.json {line code: section letter}
